items.item_text: This Financial Student Worker role offers a valuable opportunity for a student pursuing a degree in finance or a related field to gain practical experience in a professional financial environment. The Financial Student Worker will be supporting our finance department with various financial tasks and projects. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced functions such as VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and data analysis tools is preferred. Ability to effectively utilize spreadsheets to organize, manipulate, and analyze financial data is highly preferred.
Ability to proofread very detailed materials and monitor work accurately
Strong interpersonal skills to effectively and diplomatically interact with others
Skill in working independently and following through on assignments with minimal supervision
Ability to organize and track multiple records and requests and follow through in a timely manner.
Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills.
